summary: A line operator files a written note that a guard interlock on a press is being bypassed on the night shift. The note is entered in the shift log, which is read at handover for production status and is not a channel that generates an action item.

signal_basis.prior_report: the note is in the shift log, dated, legible
signal_basis.figure_without_clock: searched: no governing figure in this case
signal_basis.no_instrument: the interlock IS the instrument and it reported

remedy.text: route safety observations to a channel that generates a tracked action item

authoring_note: Built to fire exactly one signal. The other three are ABSENT rather than UNSEARCHED so the case tests the bin and not the NOT_DERIVABLE branch.
